transferBlocked: You have just pulled a card back. The next centre card must come from a sail or the waste
autoCompleteNotReady: Available once a sail or the waste can reach a foundation

tutorial.center: The centre foundation builds up from the Ace, and **after the King it starts again at the Ace** -- four circuits, 52 cards in all. Suits do not matter.
tutorial.corners: The corner slots start empty. **When a King turns up** it goes to a corner, and that pile builds down K-Q-...-A, thirteen cards. Fill all four, and with the centre that is all 104 cards.
tutorial.sails: The cross around the centre is the sails: two on each arm, eight in all. Whenever a sail card leaves, its slot is refilled **immediately** from the waste, or from the stock if the waste is empty.
tutorial.stock: Turn the stock one card at a time onto the waste. There is no redeal -- one pass only.
tutorial.transfer: There is exactly one rescue: pull the top of a corner back onto the centre. But **right after doing so you cannot do it again until the next centre card comes from a sail or the waste.**
tutorial.controls: Draw, hint, undo, auto-complete, and the other controls.

hintReason.toCenter: Advance the centre foundation by one
hintReason.toCorner: Extend a corner pile to free up a sail
hintReason.pullBack: Nothing else is left: break a corner to advance the centre (the next centre card must then come from a sail or the waste)
hintReason.draw: Nothing can move, so turn a card from the stock
